roadmap.goal: Story 6460 (T2): backend tests build one application host per fixture instead of one per test, and a guard keeps it that way. Test infrastructure only: same test ids (additions only where a step names them), no test deleted, skipped, ignored or weakened, no new NonParallelizable, product behaviour unchanged (the single product-side edit is one visibility keyword on Program.ConfigureHealthChecks, step 01-07). Five slices, each shippable alone: (1) guard already live, host-build timing, first move, cluster-substrate leftover; (2) schema template database, kept only if its A/B passes; (3) four biggest untimed families; (4) mid-size bases, the families the guard found that the classifier did not see, and the rate-limit fixtures; (5, optional) long tail. Payoff is measured by the lead after each push (CI step median, summed time of moved classes), never asserted by a test. Savings in the workspace are unmeasured ceilings.
roadmap.rigor: standard for all five slices (crafter sonnet, reviewer haiku), agreed with the maintainer on 2026-11-01 for T1, T2 and FE7; the model is passed explicitly on every dispatch.
preconditions: P-prereq (done, no step): the gate-round-2 owed items are committed as 53e6d4686. The scaffold 827ab7eb8 is the first local commit of slice 1.

Push rule: the maintainer chose one push per slice, so slice 1's forced-full CI run (Program.cs edit, 268 extra live-connector tests, Linear key shared with CI) is accepted; the lead announces it. Slice 1 is pushed as ONE unit: 827ab7eb8, e795f94c8, 95a46eca5, 5c095942a, 53e6d4686 and every 01-xx commit. The scaffold is never pushed alone. Crafters push nothing.

P-D1 (lead): the host-build timing run needs a quiet machine (LIGHTHOUSE_FIXTURE_TIMING=1, LIGHTHOUSE_TEST_WORKERS=6, standard filter). Its result re-sizes slices 3, 4 and 5, which is why those phases are coarse.

P-after (lead, after each push): wait for 7 successful main runs containing the slice (slice-1 run excluded), download test-timings-backend, compute per-class medians with measurement/scripts/cistats.py, compare with the saved baseline. Win rule fixed in advance: step median down 60 s, or moved classes down 50 percent of the slice ceiling (slice 1: 33 s, 2: 75 s, 3: 90 s, 4: 75 s, 5: 25 s); otherwise a failed prediction reported with the numbers.
P-memory (lead): a full run above 4.73 GB (4.3 GB reference at 6 workers, commit b573b1924, +10 percent) stops the track.

P-end (lead, after the last slice that ships): 3 consecutive green full standard-filter runs at 6 workers plus one at 4 workers. Green = only the two known publish-output scans fail. BackendTestParallelizationGuardTest stays green and unchanged. Standard filter: TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration.
P-hold (maintainer): a full backend run on Windows after slice 1 and after slice 2 if the template ships.
Mutation: not owed (Stryker mutates the product assembly only; the one product edit is an access modifier).

Id check: steps that add tests (01-03, 02-01, 02-02, 03-01, 04-04, 04-05, 04-06 and lead steps 01-10, 02-05, 03-07, 04-07) use an addition-aware check: ids before are a subset of ids after and the additions are exactly the named new tests. All other steps: ids equal.

Rationale and implementation detail per step is in feature-delta.md, section 'Wave: DELIVER / [REF] Roadmap notes'. Slices 3 to 5 are re-sized by the lead after step 01-02 and their steps are coarse until then.
review_resolutions: B1 addition-aware id check added to every step that adds tests. B2 mandatory step 04-05 for the classifier-unseen families. B3 slice 2 A/B-fail branch: revert 02-01 and 02-02, no push, slice 3 depends on 02-03. B4 P-prereq cites 53e6d4686. B5 step descriptions cut to 50 words or fewer; detail moved to feature-delta.md. N1 dependencies fixed. N2 rate-limit fixtures own step 04-06 (one derived host per configuration only). N3 TaskManager split per base. N6 rigor cited. N7 IL-guard fallback recorded in 01-10. N8 01-09 expected no-op. N9 slice 1 push unit listed. 01-07 no longer has a decline fallback.

steps.name: Triage the tail: apply the 25 percent rule and write the reasons
steps.description: For each remaining entry decide convert (host-build share 25 percent or more of class time) or keep with a written reason (body-bound, runs on a Postgres server, checks the test host itself, one test only). Examine the 13 never-read types.
criteria: Every entry has a plain-words reason or is queued for 05-02 with its measured share recorded
Any of the 13 never-read types that does not start a host per test is removed and the ceiling lowered in the same commit
Guard green both directions; dotnet build zero warnings; no internal references or nWave scenario tags in code
steps.scenario_name: An entry that stays gets a written reason

steps.name: Convert the tail files that pass the rule, in batches
steps.description: Convert the files queued by 05-01 in batches of related files, one commit per batch, with the full per-conversion checks. Stop at any file when the saving is not worth the risk; it stays listed with a reason.
criteria: Each batch: host once per fixture, ids equal, passes alone 3 times in a row, first and last test alone, no weakening, ceiling lowered in the same commit
Files not converted stay listed with a written reason; guard green after every batch
dotnet build zero warnings; no internal references or nWave scenario tags in code
steps.scenario_name: Same checks as slice 1, per file
files_to_modify: the tail fixtures queued by 05-01 (named by the lead)
steps.estimated_size: L (1 to 3 days; coarse, split by batch once 05-01 names the queue)

steps.name: Finish the ratchet; lead pre-push checks and push
steps.description: If the list is empty, replace it with a plain 'no type starts a host for every test' assertion; otherwise keep only reasoned entries with the ceiling equal to the size. Then the lead checks, pushes and starts the CI after-measurement.
criteria: Final guard shape is the empty-list rule, or every entry has a written reason and the ceiling equals the size
BackendTestParallelizationGuardTest green and unchanged (no entry added by the whole track)
Lead checks recorded and green; slice 5 pushed; CI after-measurement started
steps.scenario_name: Slice 5 end state and end-of-track checks
